# 02: 公共工厂生命周期与 actions 路由

**What to build:** 扩展通过同一公共声明与工厂获得已校验配置、一次初始化、完整清理和可等待的动作执行；现有调用方继续可用。

**Delivers:** P28, P56

**Blocked by:** None (can start immediately)

**Status:** ready-for-agent

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] 公共 authoring 信息从 OMP 专属类型独立，复用既有公开入口；配置读取/校验先于工厂，工厂创建时不发远端请求或启动 timer。
- [ ] 认证可读节点初始化一次，首模型请求等待初始化收口；绑定失败清理已创建资源，卸载/结束停止交付、解绑订阅、失效旧访问并只清理一次。
- [ ] 普通模型/Session/tree/查看变化不销毁 CLI 业务实例；一般异步保存不成为后续事件或输入屏障，同步异常和 Promise rejection 均被承接。
- [ ] actions 去空白、忽略大小写并完整匹配；空参帮助，缩写/额外参数/非法参数 error 加同一帮助且不执行，不借 directed.unrecognized。
- [ ] 宿主链等待同步或异步 action 完成，未处理错误只报告一次，不自动重试/回滚或先通知成功；命令阶段业务验证由 19 负责。
- [ ] 本票变更公共契约时，同票迁移全部受影响调用方及有效行为 tests，保持 CI 可用；不得将编译修复推迟到 22/23，不留旧装配类型或兼容转发双轨。
- [ ] 通过生产公共绑定与受控 adapter 验证配置→工厂→初始化顺序、生命周期、动作语法和异步承接，并在隔离真实 loader/RPC 验证加载、命令及清理。
- [ ] 通过批准的生产公共 seam 观察行为，预期来自合同/规格、独立字面值或手算，不以被测实现重算；永久网络 tests 使用 mock。
- [ ] 使用隔离安装/配置/工作/Session/数据根，不操作正式 OMP；承接异步失败并保留够用脱敏证据，完成本票自动检查及材料准备，不因计划人工验收暂停可执行工作。

本票负责所列 Delivers 的自动 coverage 与适用宿主贯通/证据准备；P58/P52 按本票具名责任执行。合同采用 Rapid iteration：H1/H2 及允许的条件性 H3 按原 Coverage 交用户确认，未确认不记通过；不改变承诺或免除实现/永久 tests。

tdd_result.description: Extend public factory lifecycle and actions routing

behavior_delivered.public_authoring_surface: framework/core/assembly.ts (new): ExtensionAssembly (factory, requiredSemantics, configBaseDir), ExtensionFactory, ImplementationContext, ExtensionImplementation (commands, events, initialize, cleanup), InitializationDelivery, CommandAction/ActionsCommandImplementation/CommandImplementations, normalizeCommandArgument, isPlainMapping. Re-exported as types through framework/public.ts; that entry still has exactly one runtime export (defineExtension). The OMP-specific OmpAdapterOptions and the adapter's authoring type re-exports are deleted.
behavior_delivered.actions_control_kind: framework/core/definition.ts: CommandActionsDeclaration added to the closed union and BOUND_CONTROL_KINDS; framework/core/violations.ts adds the actions-table violation (empty table, name that normalizes to nothing, two names one argument cannot tell apart); framework/behaviors/actions.ts (new) owns help, routing (trim + lowercase + whole match), awaiting the action, and the single error report; framework/core/protocol.ts adds ActionDelivery (invocation facts only, no declared-value seam); BoundCommand.run and the OMP command handler return the action's promise so the host chain waits.
behavior_delivered.implementation_factory_and_lifecycle: framework/behaviors/binding.ts: configuration rules and file validation run first, then the factory is called with the validated values, then declaration/implementation pairs, admission and registration; every refusal after the factory runs the implementation's one cleanup. framework/behaviors/lifecycle.ts (new): initialize at most once at the owner session node, its promise handed to the run-initiation hook so the first model request waits, cleared once settled; cleanup at most once when the session that initialized the instance ends, after which the binding delivers nothing; the initializing owner key is what makes a subagent's session end harmless. framework/adapters/omp.ts: per-adapter implementation memo (one business instance per adapter/process), awaitable before_agent_start. framework/behaviors/session-events.ts and round-events.ts contain promise rejections exactly as synchronous throws, without awaiting them.
behavior_delivered.consumer_migration: extensions/connect-bot/harnesses/omp.ts migrated from { actions, events } to { factory: () => ({ commands, events }) }; codebase-tools needed no change (no options).

criteria_evidence.criterion: public authoring info independent of OMP types; config read/validated before the factory; creation is not an effect
criteria_evidence.evidence: assembly.ts/public.ts exports; binding.ts ordering; tests/framework/implementation-lifecycle.test.ts: 'the factory receives the values the declared file was validated to carry', 'a definition whose configuration is illegal never reaches a factory' (factory call count 0), 'binding performs no delivery and no initialization of its own'. Limitation: the framework cannot observe whether an extension's own factory body makes a network call or starts a timer; only the framework's part of the rule (nothing else runs at creation, and the factory is unreachable until the configuration validated) is observed.

criteria_evidence.criterion: initialization once at the auth-readable node, first model request waits; binding failure cleans created resources; unload/end stops delivery, invalidates old access, cleans exactly once
criteria_evidence.evidence: lifecycle tests 'the initialization runs once, at the first owner session, and is not repeated', 'a session that keeps its identity, and a subagent's session, never initialize again', 'the first model request is handed the contribution only after the initialization settled', 'the session that initialized the instance ends it, and a second end cleans nothing again', 'a session end that is not the initializing owner's never ends the instance', 'after the cleanup the binding stops delivering to the extension', 'a refused binding cleans up what the factory already built'; isolated real host: tests/harness-dock/binding-lifecycle.test.ts. Old access invalidation is the existing owner-cell retirement (owner-capability tests remain green).

criteria_evidence.criterion: ordinary model/Session/tree/view changes do not destroy the CLI business instance; a general async save is not a barrier; sync throws and rejections are contained
criteria_evidence.evidence: lifecycle test 'a second binding reuses the implementation the first one built' (one factory call across two bindings of one adapter) plus the identity/subagent case; handler tests 'an asynchronous handler's rejection is reported once, after the delivery already returned' and 'a synchronous throw is reported once and still lets the framework's own behavior stand'; session-events/round-events containment.
